question: Should the recorder and five-provider fidelity changes land together after rebase, or should the series be split to reduce compatibility and message-delivery risk?
rationale: The repository policy favors provider-native behavior, but tests alone cannot decide whether the combined stricter contracts and sequencing changes are acceptable for existing Crabline users.

options.title: Rebase and validate together
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, remove the changelog entry, and land the combined series after focused provider-client or authoritative protocol verification.

options.title: Split by behavior area
options.body: Separate recorder durability from provider-specific fidelity changes so compatibility and delivery behavior can be reviewed and reverted independently.

options.title: Pause the broad hardening
options.body: Keep the PR in draft until maintainers can verify the affected provider contracts and upgrade expectations individually.

recommendation.title: Rebase and validate together
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, remove the changelog entry, and land the combined series after focused provider-client or authoritative protocol verification.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies this MEMBER-associated contributor as the owner of the complete focused series and the clearest person to coordinate its scope and validation.
